resources.string: Your phone, on autopilot. Perform complex tasks hands-free using natural AI tool-calling.
Voice and text commands made effortless. Orbit understands context, intent, and phone actions.
Clear confirmations, live action logs, and instant undo options for every phone operation.
On-device handling with minimal data sharing. Banking apps and password managers are strictly protected and never touched.
Grant capabilities to unlock AI tool-calling. Orbit asks only when you choose to grant them.
Allows Orbit to send task completions, background alerts, and summaries.
Orbit will never send promotional spam or intrusive background ads.
Enables hands-free voice commands and real-time speech recognition.
Orbit never records audio in the background without active voice mode.
Allows Orbit to schedule events, check availability, and manage reminders.
Orbit will never delete or edit existing events without your explicit confirmation.
Enables notification summaries and automated message digests.
Orbit does not store private notification contents externally or share message data.
Exact alarms and Do Not Disturb access will be requested later when a tool specifically requires them.
